lessons.title: Intro
lessons.interactiveContent:
In software development, interacting with web services is a common task, often involving sending requests to servers.

The requests library in Python is used for making HTTP requests to a specified URL.

Make sure to pick import, followed by requests.

lessons.interactiveContent:
To use the requests library, we have to import it using the import keyword, followed by the package name requests.

Make sure to pick import, followed by requests.

Import it, then store the package in library.

Make sure to pick import, followed by requests, and finally requests.
